#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>
#include <utility>

using namespace std;

const int INF = (int)1e8;

int main() {
    ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(0);
    cout.tie(0);

    int n, k;
    cin >> n >> k;

    vector<pair<int, int>> intervals(k + 2);
    intervals[0] = {0, 0};
    for (int i = 1; i <= k; ++i) {
        cin >> intervals[i].first >> intervals[i].second;
    }
    intervals[k + 1] = {2 * n, 2 * n};
    k++; // now k = original k + 1

    vector<int> dp(n + 1, INF);
    vector<int> lastDp(n + 1, INF);
    dp[0] = 0;

    for (int i = 1; i <= k; ++i) {
        int intervalLength = intervals[i].second - intervals[i].first;
        int middleLength = intervals[i].first - intervals[i - 1].second;

        // Copy lastDp to dp with shift
        int offset = min(n + 1, intervalLength + middleLength);
        int len = max(0, n + 1 - offset);
        copy(lastDp.begin(), lastDp.begin() + len, dp.begin() + offset);
        fill(dp.begin(), dp.begin() + offset, INF);

        // Flip once
        int minX = intervals[i].second - middleLength - intervalLength;
        int maxX = intervals[i].second - middleLength;
        for (int j = 0; j <= n; ++j) {
            int minNeedTime = INF;
            int left = max(0, minX - j);
            int right = min(n, maxX - j);
            for (int t = left; t <= right; ++t) {
                if (lastDp[t] < minNeedTime) minNeedTime = lastDp[t];
            }
            dp[j] = min(dp[j], minNeedTime + 1);
        }

        // Flip twice
        for (int j = 0; j <= n; ++j) {
            int minNeedTime = INF;
            int left = max(0, j - middleLength - intervalLength);
            int right = min(n, j - middleLength);
            for (int t = left; t <= right; ++t) {
                if (lastDp[t] < minNeedTime) minNeedTime = lastDp[t];
            }
            dp[j] = min(dp[j], minNeedTime + 2);
        }

        // Swap dp and lastDp for next iteration
        swap(dp, lastDp);
    }

    int minFlipTime = INF;
    for (int t = 0; t <= n; ++t) {
        if (lastDp[t] < minFlipTime) minFlipTime = lastDp[t];
    }

    if (minFlipTime < INF) {
        cout << "Full\n" << minFlipTime << "\n";
    } else {
        cout << "Hungry\n";
    }

    return 0;
}
